# Tate Programs

Tate Programs runs fixed-scope launch reviews and small implementation sprints for paid agent APIs, x402, Pay.sh, MPP, AgentCore, MCP, JavaScript, TypeScript, and GitHub Action launches.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://tateprograms.com/) - Focused paid-offer page for private x402 launch reviews, $49 re-checks, $149 spend maps, $299 fix sprints, proof signals, and current May 2026 agent-payment market positioning.
- [Shipcheck CLI](https://tateprograms.com/shipcheck.html) - Static release-readiness scanner for JS, TS, GitHub Action, npm, and MCP repos.
- [MCP Registry Pulse](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-registry-pulse.html) - Public aggregate snapshot of MCP Registry metadata, README, STDIO, auth, and launch-proof signals.
- [MCP Registry Pulse JSON](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-registry-pulse.json) - Machine-readable aggregate data backing the Pulse page.
- [Agent Stack Radar](https://tateprograms.com/agent-stack-radar.html) - May 2026 radar for agent-native software trends: AgentCore Payments, x402, Pay.sh, MCP, live web data, browser automation, coding agents, and machine-readable docs.
- [Agent Hackathon Submission Gate](https://tateprograms.com/agent-submission-gate.html) - Browser-only submission readiness checker for agent hackathon projects, covering demo proof, eligibility, MCP/tool surfaces, x402 payments, evals, audit logs, and judge-ready evidence.
- [Launch Proof Promo Flow](https://tateprograms.com/launch-proof-promo-flow.html) - Reusable ElevenCreative Flow blueprint for turning launch proof into short product clips, social scripts, scene prompts, captions, and a publish-safe fact gate.
- [MCP Launch Trust Ledger](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-launch-trust-2026.html) - May 2026 field note for MCP product launches: scoped credentials, audit trails, tenant boundaries, STDIO command safety, registry metadata, and buyer-facing proof.
- [x402 Launch Checklist](https://tateprograms.com/x402-launch-checklist.html) - Launch-readiness checklist for x402, Pay.sh, and agent-payment demos before real value can move.
- [Pay.sh Catalog Pulse](https://tateprograms.com/pay-sh-catalog-pulse.html) - Live Pay.sh catalog snapshot for agent-paid API provider counts, pricing surfaces, free-tier coverage, and review-priority launch controls.
- [Pay.sh Catalog Pulse JSON](https://tateprograms.com/pay-sh-catalog-pulse.json) - Machine-readable data backing the Pay.sh Catalog Pulse page.
- [Pay-Skills Launch Queue](https://tateprograms.com/pay-skills-launch-queue.html) - Current public pay-skills registry PR watchlist for x402, MPP, Solana, Base, compute, commerce, wallet, and data-api launch surfaces.
- [Pay-Skills Launch Queue JSON](https://tateprograms.com/pay-skills-launch-queue.json) - Machine-readable data backing the Pay-Skills Launch Queue page.
- [x402 Ecosystem Radar](https://tateprograms.com/x402-ecosystem-radar.html) - Current public Coinbase x402 PR radar for partner listings, MCP payment endpoints, mainnet rails, discovery metadata, and launch-control review priorities.
- [x402 Ecosystem Radar JSON](https://tateprograms.com/x402-ecosystem-radar.json) - Machine-readable data backing the x402 Ecosystem Radar page.
- [x402 Surface Check](https://tateprograms.com/x402-surface-check.html) - Browser and CLI checker for x402 manifests, OpenAPI specs, Streamable HTTP MCP `tools/list` catalogs, linked `discovery_url` resource catalogs, string and nested `discovery` links, manifest-level OpenAPI links, OpenAPI examples, `routes[]` catalogs, endpoint-bearing `tools` maps, string-valued endpoint maps, direct paid endpoints, pasted 402 JSON, `schemes[]` challenge arrays, declared-price drift, cache-policy maps, accept-leg resource binding, timeout/expiry metadata, optional strict-cache findings, optional strict-proof payment-identifier and signed offer/receipt checks, credential-like public registry URL params with redacted output, contextual guide links, browser `X-PAYMENT` preflight blockers, MPP `WWW-Authenticate: Payment` headers, x402 V2 requirements headers, MCP tool-name array handling, health/status routes, HTTPS resource binding, and legacy decimal x402 v1 challenges.
- [x402 Fix Sprint](https://tateprograms.com/x402-fix-sprint.html) - Paid private re-check and small authorized implementation sprint for one x402 launch blocker: CORS, cache headers, resource echo, discovery docs, registry proof, or idempotency notes.
- [x402 Five-Attack Review](https://tateprograms.com/x402-five-attack-review.html) - Paid private May 2026 x402 readiness review mapped to finality, settlement binding, replay, cache/header handling, discovery steering, and patch order.
- [x402 Attack Surface Gate on Agensi](https://www.agensi.io/skill/dda183c1-4c47-4f39-a7f1-c4cec9004d20) - Paid SKILL.md marketplace version of the no-payment x402 and agent-payment launch review workflow for resource binding, replay, paid-but-denied, browser/CORS, cache, metadata, and settlement risks.
- [SDK Continuity Sprint](https://tateprograms.com/sdk-continuity-sprint.html) - Paid OpenAPI SDK migration and generator-continuity offer after the May 2026 Stainless hosted product wind-down: $199 continuity snapshot and $799 authorized patch sprint for generated SDKs, docs, MCP connectors, and release CI.
- [Service Catalog JSON](https://tateprograms.com/services.json) - Machine-readable fixed-scope service catalog for agent marketplaces and crawlers: $49 x402 re-check, $149 launch review, $199 SDK continuity snapshot, $249 five-attack review, $299 x402 fix sprint, $499 patch sprint, and $799 SDK migration patch sprint.

## Repositories And Packages

- [Shipcheck CLI npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/shipcheck-cli) - Public npm package, runnable with `npx --yes shipcheck-cli .`.
- [Shipcheck MCP npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/shipcheck-mcp) - Public MCP server package for running Shipcheck from MCP clients.
- [Shipcheck Action](https://github.com/TateLyman/shipcheck-action) - GitHub Action wrapper for Shipcheck.
- [Shipcheck MCP](https://github.com/TateLyman/shipcheck-mcp) - MCP server source repository.
- [Tate Programs site](https://github.com/TateLyman/tate-web-services) - Static site source.
- [x402 Cache-Safe Worker](https://github.com/TateLyman/x402-cache-safe-worker) - Cloudflare Worker starter for cache-safe x402-style payment gates with CORS, no-store/private cache policy, resource echo, and smoke tests.
- [x402 Surface Check Action](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/x402-surface-check) - GitHub Marketplace Action for running no-payment x402, MPP, Pay.sh, AgentCore-style, and HTTP 402 launch-surface checks in CI.
- [x402 Triage MCP Repo](https://github.com/TateLyman/x402-triage-mcp) - npm package source and official MCP Registry-listed server for public x402 launch triage and 402 Index watch workflows.
- [Agent Skill Trust Check Repo](https://github.com/TateLyman/agent-skill-trust-check) - Static pre-install scanner for SKILL.md, OpenClaw, Hermes, MCP, and paid agent-skill marketplace listings.
